title: FSI-AgentGov Solution Manifest
description: Per-solution metadata. Aggregated into solutions.json, where manifest.controls is projected into solutions[*].controls as the canonical downstream control-coverage export.

id.description: Canonical id; MUST equal the folder name (kebab-case).

name.description: Display name shown in the docs site and framework SPA.

description.description: One-line description; rendered in catalogs and chips.

controls.description: Framework control IDs implemented by this solution. Projected verbatim into solutions.json solutions[*].controls and the generated README catalog Controls column.

dependencies.description: Other solution ids this solution depends on. Optional. NOT projected into solutions.json.

prerequisites.description: Map of role label -> one-line prerequisite. Role label SHOULD be from the role taxonomy in CHANGELOG; deviations allowed but flagged.

verification.description: One-line description of how to verify deployment is healthy.

zones.description: Governance zones in which this solution applies. 'personal' = individual maker/Default environment, 'team' = departmental/managed, 'enterprise' = regulated/Managed. Required as of schema 1.5.0.

dataClassification.description: Highest classification of data this solution may process or surface in evidence. Optional; defaults to 'internal' when absent.

retention.description: Optional retention guidance for any evidence/output the solution produces (e.g., '7 years per SEC 17a-4').

extras.description: Free-form additive fields preserved across regeneration. NOT projected into solutions.json.
